what: plan-sciml-benchmark.md SS10m route (iii): `cli.py compare` on M05's two decisive plan pairs at three path counts. The graded count is 1000; the higher ones are driven through `cli._compare_sde` with the threshold overridden, because `--N=` is the PDE grid level and is silently ignored on the SDE path.
finding: INCONCLUSIVE at the graded count and AGREE at both higher ones. More sampling confirms the plans agree in moment space rather than separating them -- which is correct, since all three do match the closed form there. M05's 622x is a pathwise difference and R15 keeps the harness's pathwise gate out of the kernel's reach, so a moment comparison cannot see it at any sample size.
